items.title: How many units get oversold as concurrent buyers grow?
items.description: Using the exact racy code from L3 (equal read/write delay, 1 unit of starting stock), every concurrent buyer that arrives within the same round-trip window reads the same stale stock value and succeeds. Drag the number of concurrent buyers to see units oversold grow in lockstep. At 2 buyers, this reproduces L3's actual result of 1 unit oversold.
